workloads.name: signal_update_100_rows
workloads.description: One signal write read by the root, then the update, 100 rows
workloads.exercises: signal write, re-render, whole-tree cascade and layout

workloads.name: signal_update_1k_rows
workloads.description: One signal write read by the root, then the update, 1,000 rows
workloads.exercises: signal write, re-render, whole-tree cascade and layout

workloads.name: signal_update_10k_rows
workloads.description: One signal write read by the root, then the update, 10,000 rows
workloads.exercises: signal write, re-render, whole-tree cascade and layout

workloads.name: signal_frame_1k_rows
workloads.description: A local state change shown on screen: write, update, paint, 1,000 rows
workloads.exercises: the whole path from a signal write to a painted frame

workloads.name: resize_1k_rows
workloads.description: Alternate between two window widths and paint, 1,000 rows
workloads.exercises: layout at a new width, paint at a new size

workloads.name: scroll_1k_rows
workloads.description: One wheel notch over a scroll box of 1,000 rows, then paint
workloads.exercises: wheel input, scroll offset update, update, paint with clipping

workloads.name: hover_1k_rows
workloads.description: Move the pointer to another row and paint, 1,000 rows
workloads.exercises: hit test, hover state, restyle of the changed rows, paint

workloads.name: deep_100_levels
workloads.description: Update and paint of a row nested 100 levels deep
workloads.exercises: deep cascade inheritance, deep layout, deep paint

workloads.name: text_200_paragraphs
workloads.description: Update and paint of 200 wrapped paragraphs with inline spans
workloads.exercises: inline shaping, line breaking, text paint

workloads.name: text_reflow_200_paragraphs
workloads.description: Alternate between two widths so 200 paragraphs reflow, then paint
workloads.exercises: line breaking at a new width, text paint

workloads.name: clips_shadows_500_cards
workloads.description: Update and paint of 500 cards with nested clips, radii and shadows
workloads.exercises: clip masks, rounded corners, box-shadow blur

workloads.name: startup_1k_rows
workloads.description: Create a window with 1,000 rows and paint its first frame
workloads.exercises: stylesheet parse, first render, first layout, first paint, font and cache warm-up
